[[File:Hearts_and_Minds_DA.png|thumb|right|250px|The Rebellion records stormtroopers brutalizing citizens for propaganda material]]
{{Quote|Our Empire may yet be young, but it is strong! While Emperor Palpatine rules from Coruscant, our valiant Clone Army continues to keep us safe from the galaxy's many threats!|[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] propaganda in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]|<ref name="Dark Times—Fire Carrier 1">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 1|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Propaganda''' was a system used by various governments to sway the opinions of the public in their favor.

==History==
{{Quote|Palpatine's propagandists worked so well that many people born during the Dark Times believed the Jedi were a myth.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Antagonize.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An example of propaganda used by the Rebels by painting over Imperial propaganda posters.]]
Nearly all major governments, including the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], made use of propaganda. [[Ahalas Svindren]], [[Ull Haber]], and the mysterious "[[Ryloth Resa]]" were propagandists active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Rebel Alliance used the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] as anti-Imperial propaganda, and the Republic used the exploits of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hero [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as propaganda.

A propaganda poster was a type of a placard or advertisement used by governments to transmit propaganda messages&mdash;such as justifying involvement to its citizens, ensuring recruitment or procuring [[Currency/Legends|money]] and resources to sustain the war effort. The Rebel Alliance made use of such placards during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

The [[Meatlumps]] employed the use of propaganda in the form of [[Graffiti/Legends|graffiti]], and the printing of manifestos which promoted their views.

During the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Brenn Tantor]] employed Imperials to tear down Rebel propaganda posters which proclaimed "Remember Alderaan" and put up posters which promoted the Empire. The Rebels struck back by graffiti-tagging the Imperial posters.

[[File:Propagandist_DA.png|thumb|180px|A propagandist]]
In some cases, propaganda can also be used to record events in such a manner that make it seem as though a faction actually won when they really lost. A notable example of this was the [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] ''[[Sacrifice at Endor]]'', which depicted the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in a pro-Imperial light, indicating that the Rebels created the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] and that the Empire tried to stop it, with Vader and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] giving their lives to destroy the weapon (which if anything, was the exact opposite of how the battle actually played out). It was done well enough that even the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Ace Pilot [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who was a veteran of the battle and thus knew the truth of how it transpired, nonetheless viewed it as being just as compelling as the history.<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gambit">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

In some cases, propaganda can also be used to make a person, namely a leader more appealing in appearance than he actually is, which is often done by state-run media. In the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', the picture of Palpatine depicted him in his Clone Wars-era appearance while listing him as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] at the time the image was taken, although it nonetheless showcased his true appearance near the end of the book.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
